# Real-Time Collaboration Tool for Consulting Clients  

A frontend-first solution enabling live document editing, commenting, and version history for consulting teams. Built to integrate with backend WebSocket services for seamless real-time sync across multiple stakeholders.  

## Deployment  
Hosted on Vercel with static site generation, optimized for global CDN delivery. WebSocket connectivity is managed via a separate backend service (not included in this repo). Ensure backend endpoint URLs are configured in `.env` before deployment.  

## Getting Started / Installation  
Clone the repository and install dependencies:  
```bash  
npm install  
```  
Set up environment variables for WebSocket URLs and API keys. Run the dev server with `npm run dev` for hot-reloading and live-preview capabilities.  

## Usage / Examples  
- **Live editing**: Open multiple browser tabs to collaboratively edit a document.  
- **Commenting**: Right-click any text to add inline notes visible to all participants.  
- **Version history**: Access past revisions via the sidebar timeline.  
- **Accessibility**: Screen readers navigate comments and edits via semantic ARIA labels.  

## Tech Stack  
- **React** with **TypeScript** for type-safe component architecture  
- **Next.js** for server-side rendering and dynamic routing  
- **WebSocket** for bidirectional real-time communication  
- **Tailwind CSS** for utility-first styling with dark mode support  
- **REST API** for document metadata synchronization  

## Architecture / Design  
The frontend uses a **state-driven architecture** with **Zustand** for global state management, decoupling UI logic from WebSocket handlers. **Responsive design** prioritizes mobile-first layouts with CSS Grid. **Web accessibility** is baked-in via ARIA roles and keyboard navigation, meeting WCAG 2.1 AA standards. Performance is optimized through code-splitting, lazy loading, and incremental DOM updates.
